# Guide With Figures

## About

Intro paragraph for the oversized guide fixture.

## Trade Size

All trades have a $5 minimum in both modes.

<figure><img src="/files/figure-trade-size" alt=""><figcaption>Trade size modes illustrated</figcaption></figure>

### Fixed Trade Size

Fixed dollar amounts for every trade when only Fixed is checked.

### Percentage Trade Size

Entries are a percentage of available cash; exits are a percentage of available crypto.

#### All cash example

With 100% cash the same percentage produces buys and no sells until crypto accrues.

#### All crypto example

With 100% crypto the same percentage produces sells and no buys until cash accrues.

#### Balanced example

Equal cash and crypto produce equal buy and sell sizes from the start.

#### Hybrid floor example

When both Fixed and Percentage are checked the fixed amount acts as a floor.

#### Auto-size example

If the computed size exceeds available cash or crypto the order auto-sizes down.

#### Headroom example

Keep fee and slippage headroom so the last trade can still clear.

## Buffers Scope And Timeframe

Positive buffers widen the no-action zone. Scope controls cycle size. Timeframe stacks independently.

<figure><img src="/files/figure-buffers" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Sell Buffer

Positive Sell Buffer moves the top edge out.

### Buy Buffer

Positive Buy Buffer moves the bottom edge out.

### Scope

Micro is fast and tight; macro is smooth and slow.

### Timeframe

The same buffer percent is more sensitive on shorter timeframes.

### Edge Flip Caution

Pinched negative buffers on short timeframes can flip edges so trades fire inside the former no-action zone.

### Trend Filter Interaction

Trend Filter with tight Scope can produce few or no trades when reversal candles close inside the wave.
